text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a practice session for our next
concert...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you, um... heard from
Hello?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's voice falters, as if she's
not sure
she should ask.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Smart Falcon suggests, Light
Hello hasn't
been contacting us as much
recently.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do you think she's okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I guess...
choice_data_list: They might just be busy with work,...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, none of you need to w...
It's okay, you guys don't need to ...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon, if I may. I have a question about
the lyrics
and choreography.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Oh, so my take on this line
is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I played it down just now, I
am
honestly worried about Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day,
I visit Light Hello's office.
choice_data_list: ï¼â¦â¦I'll pay her a visit toni...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Good evening. Did you tell
everybody
I'm all right like I asked?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I am all right... really. I'm already working on our next event.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you guys are the ones doing all
the hard
work—I'm just hitching a ride.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So really, I'm fine. You don't have to
worry about
me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: Could we chat for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I realized that... I don't know the first
thing about
concerts.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why would I? I was always a
backup
dancer...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
People actually had expectations of me,
once. I
enrolled in Tracen as the
granddaughter of a
legendary runner.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But I was weak. I lost race after race...
Never got
to sing in a concert, not even
once.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I felt grateful to all the fans who
supported me,
but I had no way to
convey it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That was what hurt most of all, never
being able
to tell my fans how much
they meant to me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want the girls to have that
chance.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
What's the point if everyone gets to
sing? Don't
cheapen our hard work!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
You say it's for the fans,
but to me it just sounds
like an excuse to escape from the
reality that we
can't win!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When that girl accused us of being
escapist, I
realized something.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the reason I'm so bent on
bringing back
the Grand Concert is
because I do want to run
away.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
A chance for everyone to convey their
gratitude
sounds nice, but that's just an
excuse.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I just want to be free from
the pain
and regret I still carry with me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And I thought the Grand Concert could
make it
all go away...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Pathetic,
isn't it... A "grown-up" roping a
bunch of
kids into giving her damaged
ego a boost.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'm really, truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I hope to learn lots more today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...At least you're still motivated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They say that skipping one day puts you
three
days behind, so I cannot afford to
skip a day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My current status is "itching"—itching to
dance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe... That's good.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hello?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've come to say that, after
speaking with
Trainer here, I've made up
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to apologize. For involving
you all in
this project.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I realize now that I was forcing my ideals
onto
you. Concerts are meant to be a
stage for
winners.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning is, after all, everything to us

Umamusume. It would be a grave
mistake to
tarnish those values.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A mistake, you say?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is the project truly a mistake?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Those opposed to us say, "Our fans
support us
because they know how hard
we train."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we want to give back to
them by
winning." Their argument is
coherent and
reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, ever since I first saw the
performance
Falcon prepared for the
Grand Concert...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A new program started running within
me—the
desire to convey my gratitude
in its purest form.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A fan of mine also told me that the
emotions I
convey during a race and a
concert are different.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I would like to answer her encouraging
words in
kind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is why I would like to participate in
the
Grand Concert, a stage where all can
stand side
by side.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand the importance of concerts
now. If there is a place where I can
convey my emotions, I
would like to be
there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is that a miscalculation on my part?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No, you're exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When you first told me about the Grand
Concert,
I got so excited my heart
started racing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I started imagining all the things we
could do that
would never be possible in
a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it'd be better if we didn't split
people up
into center stage or backup
dancers or anything...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that wouldn't be right. It's the
serious competition before a winning
concert that makes it so special! That's
why everyone dreams of standing center
stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I pictured a stage where everyone could be smiling!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if this project did start as a way
for
Light
Hello to come to terms with her
past...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Falcon and Bourbon have just shown,
the girls
have found another meaning in
it—something
deeply compelling.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Reconsidering... what, exactly?
choice_data_list: Won't you reconsider one more time?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: You've got it all backwards!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one begging you all for
help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all decide to rethink our goals for
the Grand
Concert once more.
